audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on Blinding Assault being a blind that makes Darius's autos miss. It is not. Riot's text: "Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area." Hindering vision is nearsight, not attack-miss.
audit.why: This is the single most damaging error here because it changes what the player does. Told his autos are turned off, a Darius backs out of Q and gives up the trade. In fact every auto still lands — he just cannot see her at range, which matters for chasing, not for hitting. The strings that got it wrong: content.mid ("Her Blinding Assault turning off your autos is the biggest problem"), spikes[0] ("nearsight-blinds your autos"), content.early ("a ranged marksman with a blind"), breakdown.early ("blinds + dashes with E" — E does not blind at all), dontsFull[0] ("Fight into her blind").
audit.corrected: Restated across tldr, report[0], mid, early, breakdown.early, spikes[0], dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, report[5], report[11] and breakdown.cooldowns: Q hinders vision at 1025 range on 9-11s, your autos still land, keep swinging.
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn Q text + cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, range 1025

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is labelled "Vault (Dash/Blind)" everywhere — in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, ahead, loading, dosFull, dontsFull and six report entries. Vault does not blind.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target." It is a dash, a slow, a brief interrupt and a disengage on 12/11/10/9/8 seconds. Calling it a blind hides the two things that actually matter: it is her only escape from Apprehend, and it puts her back at max attack range rather than next to you.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real behaviour and the real cooldown in every string long enough for the applier to accept. See notes for focus.text, which is 24 characters and therefore below the applier's threshold.
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn E text + cd 12/11/10/9/8, range 675

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] writes "Behind the Lines / Skystrike (R)". The ability is Behind Enemy Lines. The same string also claims the W slow stops her Vault, and wants.you[1] says "Land E-pull + W slow so she can't Vault (E) away" — a slow does not stop a dash.
audit.why: Flagged in the packet's suspectNames and confirmed against the kit (R: Behind Enemy Lines). The Vault claim is a mechanical impossibility: Crippling Strike applies a Move Speed slow, and dashes ignore Move Speed. The only thing that denies Vault is having it on cooldown, which is why the 8-12s number has to be on the page.
audit.corrected: Real name used in spikes[1], dontsFull[2].d and report[11]. wants.you[1] rewritten to "Apprehend her only after Vault (E) has been spent".
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn R and E text

audit.why: The packet's second suspectName flags "Her Blinding Assault" in content.mid as a probable wrong name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — Blinding Assault is Quinn's real Q, confirmed by the kit file and packet.enemyAbilities. The name was right; only the claim about what it does was wrong, which is handled above. Recording it so a later pass does not 'fix' a correct name.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Quinn six of seven rows (Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Quinn, Quinn) while Darius wins 55.28%. The packet itself carries the defect: "level chart contradicts data: Darius wins 55.28% but the chart gives Quinn 5/7 stages vs 2". The whys are also shifted a row: whys[4] talks about Level 5 while sitting on the Level 6 row, and whys[5] talks about Level 6 while sitting on the First item row.
audit.why: The page's own prose says where it turns: content.late opens "Level 6 and first item flip the lane hard", spikes[1] says Guillotine flips the matchup in lane, spikes[2] says Stridebreaker closes her kite, spikes[3] and whys[6] say she has no teamfight and no peel. Only the side tokens disagreed. Quinn owning the first four rows is real and stays — she is a ranged marksman against a 175-range melee — but everything from level 6 on belongs to Darius.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group across rows 4, 5 and 6: win[4] Skill -> Darius, win[5] and win[6] Quinn -> Darius; phases[4].side Skill -> Darius (5/10 -> 6/10), phases[5] and phases[6] Quinn -> Darius (4/10 -> 7/10 each). Final chart: Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Darius, Darius, Darius. The off-by-one whys were re-slotted: whys[4] now covers Level 6, whys[5] covers First item, whys[6] covers 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD at 8/10 against a 55.28% Darius win rate, and breakdown.carry states 7.5/10 while carryRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] all say 8.5/10.
audit.why: Two separate problems. The 8/10 overstates a matchup Darius wins outright — the lane phase is genuinely rough but the game is not. And the carry threat number is printed two different ways on the same page, which is the kind of thing a reader notices immediately.
audit.corrected: diff HARD -> TRICKY, diffRating 8/10 -> 6.5/10, and both prose mentions updated. breakdown.carry corrected to 8.5/10 to match carryRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.trading contains a literal PDF page artefact in the middle of the advice: "• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 62". The advice around it is generic "them/their" boilerplate that never names a Quinn ability.
audit.why: The artefact is scrape contamination shipped to a live page. The boilerplate is worse than useless in this matchup specifically, because the pattern it describes — step up, auto, Crippling Strike reset, step back — requires her to be in melee range, which against Quinn only happens when she chooses it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the three things that actually decide a Quinn trade: her Harrier mark rhythm, her Vault window, and what happens if you walk in while Vault is up.
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn P, W, E text

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gives no numbers, calls Vault "Her self-peel", and instructs the player to save Apprehend "to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight" — Apprehend does not stop dashes.
audit.why: This lane is a cooldown-counting exercise and the page had none of the counts. Vault 12s down to 8s, Blinding Assault 11s down to 9s, Apprehend 26s down to 16s. Those three numbers are the entire matchup: Darius wins only in the seconds when hers are down and his is up.
audit.corrected: All three listed with rank ranges and what each one decides.
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn Q and E cds

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why says this is the "Optimal lane control window for Darius to establish strict minion freezes" against a ranged laner who can shove from 1025 range at will.
audit.why: Darius cannot freeze against Quinn — she pushes the wave with Q plus Harrier-marked autos from outside his reach whenever she wants the wave shoved. His real plan is taking the wave under tower and counting her cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits quinn Q range 1025, P text

audit.corrected: Rewritten in plain words, keyed to Quinn's health pool and the Vault window.

If they panic and waste their primary mobility or crowd control tool, activate Ghost immediately, pull them back with Apprehend, and stack your passive to full for an easy execution loop. • • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 62 Bad trade: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.

notes:
NOT FIXED, needs a structural repair outside the length band: full.breakdown.wave and full.report[4].t are the same ~1280-character string and both contain PDF scrape contamination — the section headers "Key Mechanical Cooldowns" and "How Darius Wins Trades" are embedded mid-paragraph along with two bullet glyphs ("• •"), and the entire cooldown block and trading block are duplicated inside the wave-management text. The correct fix is deleting the injected blocks, which is roughly a 60% length reduction and would be rejected by the ±10% band, so I left it rather than pad it back out with filler. Related: full.breakdown.trading had the same contamination in the form of a literal page number ("• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 62") — that one I did rewrite in-band. Worth grepping darius.full.js for 'Matchup Database' and '• •' across every matchup, since this looks like a systematic scrape artefact rather than a one-off.

CANNOT EDIT: full.focus.text is "Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind)" — 24 characters, below the applier's 25-character skip threshold, so the fabricated "(Dash/Blind)" label survives there and in full.loading's short fragments even though I corrected it everywhere else. Needs a direct fix by tools/apply-proposals.js or a threshold exemption.

DATA INCONSISTENCY: the brief's top-level games is 964 but packet.games is 758, and the 55.28% win rate is reported against the 758 figure. Not something I acted on.

Quinn's R shows cd "3" in the kit file, which is the recast/exit timer rather than the ability's real cooldown, so I made no cooldown claim about Behind Enemy Lines anywhere — only that it is a channel CC cancels (from the channel flag) and a roam tool (from Riot's text). Darius's E carries a 'knockup' flag but Riot's text says he "pulls them to him"; I wrote pull, never knockup.
